originalTitle: Trump hosts back-to-back meetings with Zelenskyy and Netanyahu
summary: Ukraine seeks more firepower for air defenses and Israeli prime minister tries to repair relationship with US president
content: Donald Trump hosted back-to-back White House meetings with Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Benjamin Netanyahu on Tuesday, as Ukraine seeks more firepower for its air defenses and the Israeli prime minister tries to repair his strained relationship with the US president. It was Netanyahu’s first visit to the Oval Office since he and Trump launched their joint military campaign against Iran on 28 February. Netanyahu’s relationship with Trump has been complicated in recent weeks by his push to keep fighting Iran and Hezbollah in Lebanon, even as Trump pursued a diplomatic opening with Tehran. Tensions between the pair have risen as the war has drifted inconclusively, with Trump calling the Israeli premier “crazy” and declaring: “Without me, there would be no Israel.” The two men are each facing pressure at home, with Netanyahu in a tough re-election fight, and Trump under pressure to end an unpopular war that has pushed up prices before November’s midterms. Trump signaled some of that friction beforehand. Asked on Fox & Friends on Tuesday morning about reports that Netanyahu planned to brief him on intelligence about Iranian activity at Pickaxe Mountain, a suspected nuclear site Trump has threatened to bomb, he said he knew “exactly what’s going on at Pickaxe”, adding that Netanyahu raises it because “he wants me to stay involved”. Far outside the White House, behind the fences, protesters chanted: “Netanyahu, you’re a tyrant” and “Bibi, you’re not welcome here” on Tuesday. The closed-door meeting, which lasted about an hour, was expected to cover Iran, a framework deal the US and Israel signed with Lebanon, and a possible expansion of the Abraham accords, according to a White House official. Netanyahu also faces the task of reassuring Trump he will not obstruct US-led diplomacy in Gaza and Lebanon, as support for Israel among the US public has slipped, with a new AP-Norc poll showing a sharp decline amid accusations, denied by Israel, that its conduct in Gaza amounts to genocide. Zelenskyy’s meeting was described by both sides as positive. In a statement, Zelenskyy said he had discussed licensing arrangements to let Ukraine manufacture its own interceptors for Patriot missile systems. “We also spoke about diplomacy – it’s important that the diplomatic process be reinvigorated,” said Zelenskyy. “Our teams will arrange the details of their further communication. I am grateful to the United States for its firm support.” He opened by offering condolences over the death of the US senator Lindsey Graham, calling the late foreign policy hawk “a true friend of Ukraine”.Graham died suddenly earlier this month, aged 71, shortly after returning to Washington from a trip to Kyiv. Later on Tuesday, with Zelenskyy watching from the Senate gallery, the chamber advanced a sweeping Russia sanctions bill in tribute to Graham. The bill, renamed the Lindsey O Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026, easily cleared a procedural hurdle, 86 to 12, hours after Graham’s funeral in Washington, where the late senator was hailed as a “fierce defender of Ukraine”. Karoline Leavitt, the White House press secretary, said afterwards that both meetings had been “positive and productive!”
chineseTitle: 特朗普连续与泽伦斯基和内塔尼亚胡举行会晤
chineseSummary: 乌克兰寻求更多防空火力 以色列总理试图修复与美国总统的关系
chineseContent: 周二，唐纳德·特朗普在白宫连续与弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基和本杰明·内塔尼亚胡举行会议，乌克兰寻求为其防空系统提供更多火力，而以色列总理则试图修复与美国总统的紧张关系。这是内塔尼亚胡自2月28日和特朗普对伊朗发起联合军事行动以来首次访问椭圆形办公室。最近几周，内塔尼亚胡与特朗普的关系变得复杂，因为他推动继续与伊朗和黎巴嫩真主党作战，尽管特朗普寻求与德黑兰建立外交开放。随着战争毫无结果，两人之间的紧张关系加剧，特朗普称以色列总理“疯了”，并宣称：“没有我，就不会有以色列。”这两个人都面临着国内压力，内塔尼亚胡面临着艰难的连任斗争，而特朗普则面临着结束一场不受欢迎的战争的压力，这场战争在11月中期选举前推高了物价。特朗普事先就暗示了一些摩擦。周二上午，当被《福克斯与朋友》节目问及内塔尼亚胡计划向他通报有关伊朗在镐山（特朗普威胁要轰炸的疑似核设施）活动的情报时，他表示，他“确切地知道镐山正在发生什么”，并补充说，内塔尼亚胡提出这个问题是因为“他希望我继续参与其中”。周二，在白宫外远处的栅栏后面，抗议者高呼：“内塔尼亚胡，你是一个暴君”和“比比，这里不欢迎你”。据白宫官员称，这次闭门会议持续了大约一个小时，预计将讨论伊朗问题、美国和以色列与黎巴嫩签署的框架协议，以及可能扩大的亚伯拉罕协议。内塔尼亚胡还面临着向特朗普保证他不会阻碍美国主导的外交的任务。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
